_comment: Provisional VRAM cost model per Strata model on an 8 GB RTX 3060 Ti (MiB), derived from engine startup messages in this repository's benchmark logs. tools/fit_sweep.py measures the real limits; refine these numbers from its table. kv_mib = base + per_token * window for the KV cache reserved up front (--kv q4_0, no --kv-grow). max_context is the largest window the model/runtime supports (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next native 262144).
